title: Use the name 'Xdebug Helper by JetBrains'
body:
This will make more sense if the repository is also renamed to `xdebug-helper`, and a few more things will have to be changed than too. 

@pronskiy had emailed me about the naming, and I thought I'd go over it to also check for `Xdebug` vs `xdebug` in places.
author: derickr

comments.body: If you can't change it, wouldnt it make much more sense to register a new one with a fitting id?

@pronskiy @derickr Looking at it, there are only a dozen firefox users - so I don't think it would be the end of the world to delist the addon it and publish it with a new id as you suggest. 

It would just need the links in the readme updating to point to the correct add-on.
@FraserChapman okay! I believe we can republish it properly in firefox store. Let's merge then?)
